title: "rungar events"
description: "Show what the daemon has done to runners, providers and scale sets, and why"
---

Show what the daemon has done: runners created, adopted, connected, starting jobs, removed and lost, and why, with how long each step took, providers a scale set found full or failing to create its runner, and scale sets paused, resumed, and given another min_runners by their schedule. The daemon keeps them in its events file, so they explain what happened while nobody was looking, and outlive a restart. Like the journal, it writes what is kept and exits; `--follow` keeps writing new events as they happen. With `--json` it writes one JSON object a line, for scripts.

## Usage

```console
$ rungar events [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `-f`, `--follow` | Keep writing new events as they happen. |
| `--json` | Write JSON, one event a line. |
| `--provider string` | Only the events on this provider: of its runners, and of it. |
| `--runner string` | Only this runner's events. |
| `--scale-set string` | Only this scale set's events. |
| `--since string` | Only the events since a time, or for a duration: 2026-09-28, 10:30, 1h. |
| `-n`, `--tail int32` | Only the last this many events (default all kept). |

## Global flags

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--socket string` | The daemon's socket (default `$RUNGAR_SOCKET`, or `/run/rungar/rungar.sock`). |
